description: Agent Legal: submit a renewal, non-renewal or termination notice with the agreement’s notice terms: the notice with the agreement, its kind (renewal, non_renewal or termination), the party giving it and the party it is addressed to, the day sent, the delivery method, the deadline it states and the day it says the renewal or termination takes effect; the terms with the agreement, each party, the last day of the current term, the notice period in days or in months, the earliest notice in days before the term ends and each delivery method the clause allows. The signed report gives the notice and the terms, the window from the day it opens to the deadline the clause gives, counted back from the end of the term, the day sent against that window, the deadline the notice states against the deadline the clause gives, and the delivery method against the methods allowed, and counts them, and names a divergent notice: a notice sent outside the window the agreement sets, a deadline computed unlike the notice clause and a delivery method the clause does not allow; then an effective day unlike the term, a sender or addressee the agreement does not name and another agreement name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Terms with no end of term or notice period, a notice with no day sent where the clause sets a window, or no delivery method where the clause allows set methods leaves the notice unverified. The deadline counts back by days or to the same calendar day for months, days read as days, and methods read by their words with plurals folded. This reads a notice actually sent against the notice clause: wever_renewal-notice-check reads agreement text or renewal fields with a current date and works out the renewal type, the current term rolled forward and the notice deadline, while the renewal check reads a notice that was sent against the clause, for when it went, the deadline it states and how it was delivered. Verdict legal_renewal_divergent, legal_renewal_partial, legal_renewal_unverified or legal_renewal_consistent. POST /api/legal-renewal-check. Reads the contract records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never drafts, negotiates, signs or files anything, judges no fairness of terms and no readiness of a deal to settle, and leaves enforceability, interpretation and legal advice to lawyers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Legal reads contract records across the agreement lifecycle for consistency between documents: an executed agreement, a statement of work, an order form, an amendment, an execution record, a renewal or termination notice, the exhibits attached to an agreement and an assignment record, each against the term sheet or deal summary, the master agreement, the pricing terms and the quote, the agreement it amends, the signature requirements, the notice clause, the exhibits the agreement references or the assignment clause it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral and compares different documents with each other, not versions of one document. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-legal-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-legal/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

agreement.description: The agreement the document names, by its title or reference.

effective_on.description: The day the notice says the renewal or termination takes effect, such as 2026-10-15.

method.description: How the notice was delivered, such as email, courier or registered mail.

sent_on.description: When the notice was sent, such as 2026-10-15.

stated_deadline.description: The notice deadline the notice states, such as 2026-10-15.

to.description: The party the notice is addressed to.

agreement.description: The agreement the document names, by its title or reference.

methods.description: Each delivery method the notice clause allows.

notice_days.description: The notice the clause requires before the term ends, in days.

notice_months.description: The notice the clause requires before the term ends, in months, when the clause states months.

term_ends_on.description: The last day of the current term, such as 2026-10-15.

window_days.description: The earliest the clause allows notice, in days before the term ends, when it sets a window.
